keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 macro nature photo. One wide green milkweed leaf sticks out horizontally from a thin stem and crosses the middle of the frame. The camera is slightly above the leaf, so the top of the leaf is visible, with empty space below the leaf. Background: soft out-of-focus green garden. One adult monarch butterfly stands on the top of the leaf near the center, wings closed upright, its abdomen curved down to touch the leaf. Soft daylight, shallow depth of field. Keep the leaf and the butterfly in the center, away from the left and right edges. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the leaf, stem, background, lighting and camera angle exactly the same. Remove the butterfly. One tiny cream-white monarch egg sits on the top of the leaf at the spot where the butterfly's abdomen touched it.

Edit this image. Keep the stem, background, lighting and camera angle exactly the same. Remove the egg. The outer edge of the leaf now has a large chewed curve. One large monarch caterpillar with black, yellow and white stripes sits at the chewed edge of the leaf.

Edit this image (K04, đính kèm trong chat mới). Keep the leaf, the chewed edge, stem, background, lighting and camera angle exactly the same. Replace the green chrysalis with one monarch caterpillar with black, yellow and white stripes, hanging head-down in a J shape from the same spot under the leaf. Only one caterpillar.

Edit this image. Keep the leaf, the chewed edge, stem, background, lighting and camera angle exactly the same. Remove the caterpillar. One jade-green monarch chrysalis with small gold dots hangs straight down from the underside of the leaf, below the chewed edge.

Edit this image. Keep the leaf, chewed edge, stem, background, lighting and camera angle exactly the same. The chrysalis is now an empty clear shell. One adult monarch butterfly hangs from the empty shell under the leaf, with its orange and black wings fully open. The whole butterfly fits inside the frame.
Edit this image. Keep everything exactly the same. Remove the butterfly. Only the empty clear chrysalis shell hangs under the leaf.

clips.prompt: Static camera. The butterfly slowly lays one small egg on the leaf, then flies up and out of the frame. Nothing else changes.
Static camera. Time-lapse. The egg hatches and a tiny caterpillar eats the leaf edge and grows into a large caterpillar. Nothing else changes.

Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The caterpillar slowly crawls over the edge of the leaf to the underside and hangs head-down in a J shape. There is only one caterpillar. Nothing else changes.

Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The hanging caterpillar slowly shrinks and turns into a smooth green chrysalis in the same spot. There is only one caterpillar. Nothing else changes.
Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The chrysalis slowly turns clear and a monarch butterfly comes out and opens its wings. Nothing else changes.
Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. The butterfly slowly flaps its wings and flies up and out of the frame. Nothing else changes.
